text: See bd-01KZXEFHAWJ97VCRJ84JP85GA8. The only scale tests in the package are skipped unless EFFECTAGRAM_RUN_SCALE_TESTS=true, and nothing in the repo sets it - no CI, no Makefile, no .github. They pass when enabled (47/47). Epic 9 should require a recorded scale-enabled run rather than a clean default suite, or the 0.1 gate closes on evidence that was skipped.
